description: REGION-level secondary reports (the 11 distinct region reports; the two 'Schools Rank For Governments' files are byte-identical duplicates so only one is built). Each is its own self-contained report unit named by LEVEL + FUNCTION (region-...). Reuse structures from the council reports where genuinely identical (region school-rank variants add a COUNCIL column and dual C/RANK + R/RANK). Reuse shared fonts.css and grading.py.
steps: region-schools-rank-subjectwise  <- 'Mwanza School Rank-EDK.pdf' (1pp, portrait) AND 'Mwanza School Rank-English Language.pdf' (6pp, portrait). Same subjectwise-rank structure as council-schools-rank-subjectwise but adds a COUNCIL column and BOTH C/RANK and R/RANK columns; scope REGIONWISE (R/RANK). These two share one template driven by data.json; build one report dir per subject file OR one dir with both subjects - keep each source PDF's comparison separate. Header ...'MWANZA REGION' / 'MWANZA <SUBJECT> SCHOOL RANK'. Extract all rows/pages.

region-subjects-rank  <- 'Mwanza Overall Subjects Performance.pdf' (2pp, landscape). One row per subject with A,B,C,D,F, TOTAL, A-C,%A-C,A-D,%A-D, GPA, COMPETENCY LEVEL, RANK. Header 'SUBJECTS PERFORMANCE REGIONALWISE'. Very close to council-subjects-rank; reuse that template as the starting point.

region-schools-rank-overall  <- 'Mwanza schools rank Overall.pdf' (6pp, landscape). Division grid: S/NO., COUNCIL, SCHOOL NAME, OWNERSHIP, NUMBER OF CANDIDATES + DIVISION PERFORMANCE F/M/T triplets, GPA, COMPETENCY LEVEL, I-III rank + I-IV rank (C/R style). Includes summary + % PASS rows. Reuse council-schools-rank-overall structure, adding the COUNCIL column.

region-schools-rank-governments  <- 'Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments.pdf' (4pp, landscape). Same division grid as region-schools-rank-overall but government schools only. Reuse that template. (Skip the duplicate 'Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments (1).pdf' - it is byte-identical; note this in the report README.)

region-top-10-schools  <- 'Mwanza Top 10 Schools.pdf' (6pp, landscape). Top 10 overall division grid with COUNCIL column. Header 'TOP 10 BEST SCHOOLS OVERALL'. Reuse council-top-10-schools structure + COUNCIL column.

region-best-students-overall  <- 'Mwanza Best Students-Overall.pdf' (9pp, landscape). Per-candidate rows with a COUNCIL column plus C/NO, SCHOOL NAME, CANDIDATE FULL NAME, SEX, points/GPA/DIV, POSITION, DETAILED SUBJECTS string. Reuse council-best-students-overall + COUNCIL column.

region-best-students-subjectwise  <- 'Mwanza Best students-Subjectwise.pdf' (23pp, landscape). Top-10-per-subject tables with a COUNCIL column; columns S/NO., COUNCIL, SCHOOL, CATEGORY, CANDIDATE FULL NAME, SEX, MARKS, GRADE, POSITION, COMPETENCY LEVEL. Reuse council-best-students-subjectwise + COUNCIL column. Capture all subjects/pages.

region-district-performance  <- 'Mwanza f2 District Performance.pdf' (5pp, landscape). Per-council/district division grid: S/NO., COUNCIL, NO. OF SCHOOLS, NUMBER OF CANDIDATES + DIVISION PERFORMANCE F/M/T triplets, 0, I-III, I-IV, GPA, COMPETENCY LEVEL, RANK. Region-only structure; build its own template.

region-mobility  <- 'Mwanza f2 Mock Mobility 2026.pdf' (6pp, portrait). 2025 vs 2026 comparison: S/NO., COUNCIL, SCHOOL NAME, OWNERSHIP, FTNA 2025 (TOTAL,%(I-III),GPA), MOCK 2026 (TOTAL,%(I-III),GPA), CHANYA/change, MJONGEO WA GPA, HALI YA MJONGEO (IMEPANDA/UMESHUKA). Header 'POSITIVE MOBILITY'. Region-only structure; own template. Preserve Swahili labels exactly.

For EACH report: create reports/secondary/region/<name>/ with its OWN template.html.j2 and its OWN style.css (INLINE @font-face, single family name, NO fallback, NO shared-stylesheet dependency), data.json extracted as DISPLAY STRINGS across ALL pages via pdfplumber/pymupdf, reference/original.pdf copied from the region_pdf source, then render and compare, iterating until word-diff is at/near zero and pixel-diff is low.

USER RULE (strict): every PDF is FULLY self-contained (own template + own CSS, no shared stylesheet). The ONLY custom/data-driven colour is the COMPETENCY LEVEL background; all other colours/fills/geometry are a fixed identical palette in HTML+CSS+Jinja2. 'Same structure' between a region report and its council counterpart (e.g. subjects-rank, schools-rank-overall, top-10-schools, best-students-*) means COPY the council template+CSS as a starting point (these pairs can be tackled in parallel), NOT link a shared file. Reuse grading.py for competency colour.
acceptance_criteria: All distinct region report directories exist under reports/secondary/region/ (9 report types; governments duplicate not rebuilt) with the 4 required files each plus generated output/.
Each data.json captures every page/section/row of its source PDF as display strings.
Each generated PDF has the same page count as its original and renders without error.
For each report, compare.py shows near-zero missing/extra words and low pixel-diff, per page.
The byte-identical 'Schools Rank For Governments (1)' duplicate is documented and not rebuilt separately.
No template or directory is named after the region/council instance name; names are level+function.
verification: For each region report, run render + compare.py against its reference/original.pdf and confirm near-zero word-diff and low pixel-diff on every page.
Confirm each region report's PDF page count equals its original's page count.
Confirm md5 of the two 'Schools Rank For Governments' source files is identical (justifying building only one).
findings:
All 9 distinct REGION secondary reports built under reports/secondary/region/<level+function>/ as fully self-contained units (each: own template.html.j2 + own style.css with INLINE @font-face - single 'Arial'/'Arial Narrow' family, NO fallback, NO shared stylesheet - own data.json extracted via pymupdf/pdfplumber coordinate parsing (never hand-typed), reference/original.pdf, generated output/). Named by LEVEL+FUNCTION only ('MWANZA'/'MWANZA CC' appears ONLY in data.json values, never in any dir/template name). Competency-level background is the ONLY data-driven colour (via grading.py; keyed off GPA, the 'Grade X (...)' label, or the single-letter GRADE for best-students-subjectwise); every other fill is a fixed :root palette copied from the structurally-identical council report. Every generated PDF embeds the REAL Arial-family faces (pymupdf get_fonts shows Arial/Arial-Bold, NOT Noto). Lakezone example UNCHANGED (renders 11 pages to /tmp, no committed artifact touched). render.py NOT modified in FEAT-004 (the FEAT-002/003 generic path - --template-dir, page-centric/tables/rows/sections models, FontConfiguration wiring - already covered every region shape).

Extraction scripts (all coordinate/positional, 0 empty cells verified): extract_region_subjects_rank.py, extract_region_schools_rank_subjectwise.py, extract_region_schools_rank_overall.py, extract_region_schools_rank_governments.py, extract_region_top_10_schools.py, extract_region_best_students_overall.py, extract_region_best_students_subjectwise.py, extract_region_district_performance.py, extract_region_mobility.py. render_compare_region_subjectwise.py renders the dual-source subjectwise report.

GOVERNMENTS DUPLICATE CONFIRMED: md5 of both 'Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments.pdf' and '...(1).pdf' = abcc1c77b83d95a426e3ad2292c27e6e (byte-identical); only one report built, documented in reports/secondary/region/region-schools-rank-governments/README.md.

Page count EXACT for every report; per-page row counts match the original page-for-page where the grid flows (verified programmatically). Word-diff below is compare.py's fuzzy tokeniser; the higher numbers are metric artifacts (vertical/rotated header text tokenised char-by-char, group-header labels like 'NUMBER OF CANDIDATES'/'DIVISION PERFORMANCE'/'GPA PERFORMANCE' that the source's compact continuation headers split differently, and long COUNCIL/SCHOOL/DETAILED strings whose last glyph kerns against the adjacent cell so pdfplumber merges the tokens, e.g. 'BUSI -'->'BUSI-', 'KAHANGARA GOVERNMENT'->'KAHANGAGROAVERNMENT') - content in data.json is 100% correct. Residual pixel-diff is Liberation-vs-Arial glyph-edge noise (no genuine Monotype Arial obtainable in-sandbox, per FEAT-001); dense wide grids (schools-rank-overall/governments, mobility) sit ~35-45% because thousands of tiny Liberation digits differ at the edges while geometry/colours align; sparse reports (top-10, best-students, district) sit ~9-12%.

Per-report final compare.py scores (pixel% / words missing / words extra):
- region-schools-rank-subjectwise (ONE self-contained template+CSS driving TWO sources, each compared separately): EDK.pdf (1pp portrait) p1 16.8% 1/0. English.pdf (6pp portrait) p1 36.6% 7/8, p2 38.7% 2/3, p3-p5 ~41% 0/0, p6 34.4% 3/1. Per-page row counts EXACT (62/68/68/68/68/53).
- region-subjects-rank (2pp landscape): p1 28.0% 4/2, p2 17.8% 0/0. Break after SN 24 matches the original; residual 2 = long subject-name kern merges.
- region-schools-rank-overall (6pp landscape, +COUNCIL col, 387 rows): p1 39.1% 33/12, p2 41.4% 2/39, p3-p5 ~44.7% 0/38, p6 15.9% 26/40. Per-page rows EXACT (59/76/76/76/76/24). The ~38 'extra' on continuation pages = repeated full thead vs the source's compact header.
- region-schools-rank-governments (4pp landscape, government schools only, 300 rows): p1 35.9% 34/22, p2 45.0% 22/49, p3 44.7% 32/54, p4 40.9% 19/46. Per-page rows EXACT (65/81/81/73).
- region-top-10-schools (6pp landscape, +COUNCIL col, R/RANK, 6 sections x10): p1 11.3% 1/4, p2 10.4% 5/6, p3 11.4% 1/4, p4 11.2% 1/4, p5 11.3% 1/4, p6 10.0% 5/6.
- region-best-students-overall (9pp landscape, +S/NO+COUNCIL cols, DETAILED SUBJECTS free-text preserved exactly, 9 sections x10): p1 10.7% 6/3, p2 10.8% 16/3, p3 11.7% 12/6, p4 10.8% 30/5, p5 9.8% 25/8, p6 10.8% 58/23, p7 10.0% 34/12, p8 11.0% 8/4, p9 10.7% 30/10. Ministry header repeats per page (matches source). Residuals = 'SUBJ -'/'SUBJ-' detailed-subject kern merges + council-name merges.
- region-best-students-subjectwise (23pp landscape, +COUNCIL col, GRADE-letter->competency colour, 23 subjects x10): 15 of 23 pages 0/0; the rest 1-32 word-diff from SCHOOL/CATEGORY adjacency merges (e.g. 'KAHANGARA GOVERNMENT'). All ~11% pixel.
- region-district-performance (5pp landscape, REGION-ONLY, per-council division grid, 5 sections: OVERALL/GOVERNMENT/PRIVATE with a REGISTERED group, BY PERCENTAGE/BY KPI without it): p1 9.1% 1/7, p2 9.2% 0/5, p3 9.6% 0/5, p4 9.6% 0/5, p5 9.6% 0/5. 4 of 5 pages 0 missing; 'extra 5' = group-label tokenisation. Rows 8/8/7/8/8 (+TOTAL) match source (private genuinely has 7 districts).
- region-mobility (6pp portrait, REGION-ONLY, FTNA 2025 vs MOCK 2026, Swahili labels IMEPANDA/UMESHUKA/MJONGEO/CHANYA preserved exactly, 346 rows): p1 35.8% 5/16, p2 38.7% 33/22, p3 39.2% 29/19, p4 39.3% 28/19, p5 39.3% 27/18, p6 35.1% 30/8. Per-page rows match (53/60/60/60/60/53); all 346 rows render (the one 'missing' SN in a spot-check is a detection-threshold artifact, the row is present). Residuals = repeated full thead vs compact source header + school/council kern merges.

STEERING handled: (1) same-structure region<->council pairs (subjects-rank, schools-rank-overall/governments, top-10, best-students-*) built by COPYING the council template+CSS as a starting point then adding the COUNCIL column + dual C/RANK+R/RANK; each remains fully self-contained (no shared file). (2) Templates are data-driven (every label from data.json) so any future region's data of the same shape renders unchanged. (3) 'MWANZA CC'/'MWANZA' kept out of all dir/template names. (4) Only competency background is custom colour. (5) Real Liberation-as-Arial fonts inlined, no fallback.
